sco-baidu-1.webp.zh: 夜色中登机：旅客沿舷梯走向 FlyArystan 的客机，红色涂装在灯光下格外醒目。
sco-baidu-1.webp.en: Boarding at night — passengers climbing the stairs to a FlyArystan aircraft, its red livery sharp under the apron lights.

sco-chatgpt-01.webp.zh: 蓝天之下，阿克套国际机场的灰色立面写着哈萨克文与英文的机场名称。
sco-chatgpt-01.webp.en: Under a clear blue sky, the grey facade of Aktau International Airport carries its name in Kazakh and English.

sco-chatgpt-02.webp.zh: 从高处望去，航站楼伸出的两条登机廊桥通向机坪，跑道在远处的地平线上。
sco-chatgpt-02.webp.en: Seen from above, two jet bridges reach out from the terminal toward the apron while the runway lies near the horizon.

sco-chatgpt-03.webp.zh: 暮色中，一架客机停在航站楼前，舷梯已经接上舱门，落日把云染成金色。
sco-chatgpt-03.webp.en: In the fading light an airliner stands before the terminal with stairs at its door, the sunset tinting the clouds gold.

sco-chatgpt-04.webp.zh: 跑道的沥青路面占满画面，白色的号码与中线一直延伸到干草地的尽头。
sco-chatgpt-04.webp.en: Asphalt fills the frame as the white threshold numerals and centreline run straight toward dry grassland at the far end.

sco-chatgpt-05.webp.zh: 几架蓝白涂装的客机并排停在廊桥旁，方形的塔台在它们身后映着晨光。
sco-chatgpt-05.webp.en: Several airliners in blue and white stand side by side at the jet bridges, a squat control tower rising behind them in the morning light.

sco-chatgpt-06.webp.zh: 一架阿斯塔纳航空的客机停在开裂的混凝土机坪上，前后舱门都放下了舷梯。
sco-chatgpt-06.webp.en: An Air Astana jet waits on a cracked concrete apron with boarding stairs set at both its front and rear doors.

sco-chatgpt-07.webp.zh: 日落后天空泛着粉紫色，机场的深色招牌亮起，门前车道空无一车。
sco-chatgpt-07.webp.en: After sunset the sky turns pink and violet as the airport's dark sign lights up above an empty forecourt.
